name: dsh-notify-win
description: Native Windows toast plus an unread badge on DSH's own notification-area icon, and an optional taskbar flash, when a task finishes or your input is needed.

scripts.check: node --check lib/config.js && node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check scripts/build-helper.mjs
scripts.test: node test/policy.mjs && node test/flash-policy.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs && node test/proof.mjs && node test/helper-protocol.mjs && node test/background-answer.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run check && npm test
